column1: # DERIVED arena graces: distance(grace spawn, nearest boss enemy spawn) < 40.0m
# A region lock force-lights every grace in its region so you can warp in. A grace INSIDE a
# boss arena must never be force-lit -- warping there drops you on a live boss.
# sources: EMEVD DisplayBossHealthBar + witchy'd MSB Part/Enemy <EntityID>/<Position>
#          + grace_flags.tsv. tools/datamine_arena_graces.py
# 🛑 ABSENCE IS NEVER AN ANSWER, AND IT IS PER-BOSS.
#   adjudicated_tiles: the map's MSB was unpacked. It does NOT mean every boss on it was
#     located -- a DisplayBossHealthBar entity that is not an MSB Part has no position and
#     is skipped. Reading 'tile adjudicated + grace absent' as 'measured safe' is the
#     2026-08-10 mistake (76931 Shadow Keep Back Gate, in front of Commander Gaius).
#   unresolved_bosses: the bosses that had NO position. A grace on one of these tiles is
#     UNADJUDICATED for that boss; gen_data's hand list stays LOAD-BEARING for it.
# boss_class is carried so a human can adjudicate: a `field` boss may be a
#   CONDITIONAL spawn (Bell Bearing Hunter is night-only) whose 'arena' is an
#   ordinary, safe, permanently-useful grace. Distance alone cannot tell those
#   from a real arena grace -- see the 2026-08-10 note in the tool docstring.
# excluded: grace 76118 boss 1042380850 @9.0m [conditional-spawn] Bell Bearing Hunter -- NIGHT-ONLY spawn at Warmaster's Shack
# excluded: grace 76311 boss 1043530800 @21.6m [conditional-spawn] Bell Bearing Hunter -- NIGHT-ONLY spawn at Hermit Merchant's Shack

# excluded: grace 76357 boss 1037530800 @36.8m [not-an-arena] Alaric, in-game 2026-08-10: Demi-Human Queen Maggie releases no grace on death, and Primeval Sorcerer Azur's grace is a separate ledge. 36.8 m.
# excluded: grace 76451 boss 1048410800 @17.4m [conditional-spawn] Bell Bearing Hunter -- NIGHT-ONLY spawn at Isolated Merchant's Shack
# excluded: grace 76910 boss 2049430850 @19.2m [not-an-arena] Alaric, in-game 2026-08-10: 'Behind the Fort of Reprimand' is not a boss grace. Black Knight Edredd at 19.2 m.
